purpose: Determine whether V45's extreme-density failure is caused by unsupported logistic-mixture component mass, a globally overdispersed train likelihood, component collapse, or a calibrated likelihood coupled to an incompatible empirical rank copula, without fitting, resampling development fields, or changing any threshold.

audit_population.objects: every frozen V35 training object: 432 TNG100, 202 SIMBA, and 409 Swift
audit_population.model: V45 EMA checkpoint in evaluation mode
audit_population.development_ensemble_role: no arrays reopened; only the already sealed V45 decision classification and summary metrics are inherited

exact_streaming_diagnostics.scope: every native voxel of every train cube
metrics: mean NLL within empirical standardized-target upper q99 and q99.9 subsets
PIT fractions below and above 0.01, 0.001, and 0.0001 tails
mean predicted mixture weights by component
mean posterior truth responsibilities by component
mean posterior truth responsibilities within target upper q99 and q99.9 subsets
mean per-voxel mixture-weight entropy and effective component count
global effective component count from mean posterior responsibilities
exact_streaming_diagnostics.responsibility_definition: softmax(log mixture weight plus component log density of the observed standardized train residual)

fixed_voxel_probe.selection: one independently seeded sample without replacement from the 64^3 flat native voxels for each domain and object
stored_parameter_summaries: component conditional upper-q99.99 standardized-residual endpoint quantiles

train_posterior_predictive_check.sampling: independent fixed uniform ranks transformed through the exact V45 28-step local mixture inverse
comparisons: standardized residual q99, q99.9, and q99.99 versus probed train truth
full log10rho q99, q99.9, and q99.99 versus probed train truth after adding the frozen backbone
mean delta squared ratio versus probed train truth

fixed_branches.condition: any domain has a component with mean weight at least 0.02 but posterior responsibility divided by weight below 0.5, and that component's median conditional upper-q99.99 standardized-residual endpoint exceeds the pooled probed train-truth q99.99 standardized residual

all domains overpredict train posterior-predictive q99.99 log10rho by more than 0.10 dex or mean delta squared by more than 1.5, while upper PIT observed-over-expected is below 0.5 at 0.001 in at least two domains
any domain has global effective posterior-responsibility component count below 3.0
every domain passes PIT 0.001 ratio in [0.5,2], absolute train posterior-predictive q99.99 log10rho within 0.10 dex, and mean delta squared ratio in [2/3,1.5]

hard_checks: clean committed worktree and exact V45 record, program, checkpoint, report, cache, preflight, and decision hashes
Lageunha Ada GPU and V45 parameter count
all train object counts and voxel-probe counts exactly match the frozen program
all NLL, PIT, weights, responsibilities, parameters, and posterior-predictive values are finite
mixture weights and posterior responsibilities each sum to one within 1e-5
no validation data, Astrid, or historical EAGLE access
